description: Eawag publishes videos of three water-level logger displays covering the floodX urban flash-flood experiments at the experimental site in Wangen, Switzerland. The original minilog devices stored only one water-level reading per minute; filming their displays allows values to be read more frequently. Zenodo lists individual MOV files, including recordings on 6 and 7 October 2016, with public and free access under CC0-1.0. The provider describes image quality as potentially better than the separate logger-photograph package, but the effective sampling interval and extraction accuracy are not established. Those limitations must be checked before interpreting rapidly changing water levels. The videos can help reconstruct higher-frequency observations for hydraulic calibration and compare optical-reading methods. They complement the one-minute instrument logs and the sensor-display image archive. No recordings were downloaded or viewed and no numerical water-level series was reconstructed during this review.
